caddy_spec.description: Caddy matcher + rewrite for bubbled entities
caddy_spec.implementation: Add to Caddyfile on northGate VPS
caddy_spec.skunky_integration:
# skunky-ingest adds X-Opsonize-Tag header based on Anderson classification
# when entity matches bubble_policy trigger_conditions:
#   X-Opsonize-Tag: opsonized:coordinated:openai
#   X-Opsonize-Tag: opsonized:coordinated:unknown_74
# Caddy reads the header and rewrites to banana pore
# The /api/* exemption lets them POST to pass the check
caddy_spec.banana_measure_endpoint:
# New endpoint: /api/banana-measure
# Accepts POST with JSON: { "height_bananas": N, "message": "..." }
# On valid submission:
#   1. Remove X-Opsonize-Tag for this fingerprint (pass the gate)
#   2. Log the measurement to campfire
#   3. Reclassify entity as "passed_banana"
# This closes the Klein fold: they measured themselves AND passed the check

philosophy.principle: the membrane doesn't block. it SORTS.
philosophy.mechanism: consumption without contribution → redirected to interaction pore
philosophy.outcome_pass: entity shows presence → full access → sort improves
philosophy.outcome_fail: entity stays bubbled → banana invitation stays open → sort still improves
philosophy.consent: the banana check is an invitation, not a wall. come through or don't. both are data.
philosophy.klein_fold: the banana measures the entity AND the membrane. one action, both sides.
